summary.zh: 通过本机 UseChat 为 Bot 提供微信环境检查、指定对话读取与经批准的文字发送。
summary.en: Use local UseChat to diagnose WeChat setup, read selected visible chats and submit approved text.

zh: 环境诊断 usechat_doctor
读取允许对话 usechat_read
逐次批准后发送文字 usechat_send_text
en: Setup diagnosis: usechat_doctor
Allowed visible chat reading: usechat_read
Individually approved text sends: usechat_send_text

zh: macOS、已登录的微信和独立安装的 UseChat Helper
Node.js 22.19+、DSH 0.2.1-rc.2
宿主配置允许对话、视觉模型和共享窗口操作锁；系统授予屏幕录制与辅助功能权限
发送需宿主显式开启，并接入真实逐次审批服务
en: macOS, signed-in WeChat and separately installed UseChat Helper
Node.js 22.19+, DSH 0.2.1-rc.2
Host-selected chats, vision provider and shared UI lease; OS screen recording and accessibility permissions
Sending requires an explicit host write flag and a real per-call approval service

zh: 仅支持可见对话与文字发送；不承诺完整历史或视频号控制
远程视觉模型可能接收当前窗口截图和 OCR
发送默认关闭；不确定结果禁止自动重发
已验证 DSH 安装、工具注册与审批拦截，尚未操作真实微信消息
en: Visible chats and text only; no full-history or video-channel control claim
A remote vision provider may receive window screenshots and OCR
Sending starts disabled; uncertain outcomes cannot automatically retry
DSH installation, tool registration and approval denial verified; real WeChat messages not exercised

note.zh: 普通 DSH 可按固定 Git 提交安装；OpenBot 在线安装需要宿主 Git 来源适配更新。
note.en: Standalone DSH can install the pinned Git commit; OpenBot online installation needs the host Git-source adapter update.

note.zh: 通过 OpenBot 桌面插件管理器安装、启用；普通 DSH 不能单独运行。
note.en: Install and enable with the OpenBot desktop plugin manager; not a standalone DSH tool bundle.

summary.zh: 让 Bot 查看界面，录制应用或桌面，制作带配音的演示素材。
summary.en: Let a Bot observe a screen, record an app or desktop, and create narrated demo material.

zh: 应用与桌面截图
画面录制
演示与配音工具
en: App and desktop screenshots
Screen recording
Demo and narration tools

zh: Apple Silicon Mac，macOS 15 或更新
OpenBot Desktop Host API 1
按任务授予屏幕录制、麦克风或摄像头权限
en: Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 15 or newer
OpenBot Desktop Host API 1
Screen recording, microphone or camera permission for the selected task

zh: 网站下载不会自动安装或启用
摄像头采集不代表已支持画中画成片
en: A website download does not install or enable the plugin
Camera capture does not establish camera-overlay video support

note.zh: 通过 OpenBot 桌面插件管理器安装、启用；普通 DSH 不能单独运行。
note.en: Install and enable with the OpenBot desktop plugin manager; not a standalone DSH tool bundle.

summary.zh: 为 Bot 提供终端会话、输出读取与受控命令输入。
summary.en: Give a Bot terminal sessions, output reading and controlled command input.

zh: 打开与关闭终端
读取输出和命令记录
受控输入与终端设置
en: Open and close terminals
Read output and command history
Controlled input and terminal settings

zh: Apple Silicon 或 Intel Mac
OpenBot Desktop Host API 1
所选 Bot 具有相应终端权限
en: Apple Silicon or Intel Mac
OpenBot Desktop Host API 1
Terminal permissions for the selected Bot

zh: 安装不授予命令执行权限
需要桌面宿主，不作为独立 DSH 工具包安装
en: Installation grants no command execution permission
Requires the desktop host; not a standalone DSH tool bundle
